messages:
Diego (Sales): Quick sync: prospect wants a 6-week EU-only pilot with hard region lock to one EU data center and client-managed keys. They asked for: exact subprocessor list in EU, audit-log residency, emergency failover process, and a single-line estimate for procurement. Can we confirm constraints? :point_up:
Priya (Presales): I can own the technical SOW. Two quick clarifiers: 1) hard lock -> Dedicated or Private only (Hosted can't guarantee hard lock). 2) Client-managed keys = BYOK/HSM. Prospect wants guarantees keys never leave EU.
Ravi (Infra): Correct. We support strict regional tenancy on Dedicated and Private. For BYOK: VaultCorp EU (partner HSM) and AWS KMS with customer CMKs confined to eu-central-1 are supported. We can ensure key material never leaves region for the POC if we use Private or Dedicated + CloudHSM.
Nora (Security): Need to confirm where audit logs live: by default logs go to ManagedLog EU (eu-central-1 retention). If customer needs separate log tenant (their own S3 bucket), Ops can configure forwarder. Also they asked about retention and deletion provable on termination . We'll need to add deletion SLA text to SOW.
Hana (Ops): For peering, we can provision two EU edge POPs (NL and DE) and create a tenant CNAME. We need customer ASN and preferred TLS termination. Template RFC and CNAME instructions available. Ops effort estimate: ~10h initial setup + 4h weekly support during POC.
Diego (Sales): Procurement asked for one-line price they can include in an internal PO. Can ops/legal give a one-line with one-time setup + monthly? They want to avoid detailed line items at first.
Hana (Ops): One-line (ballpark): "EU-only POC (Dedicated reservation, region lock, BYOK) — est. $28,500/month + $9,500 one-time integration." That includes reserved GPUs, +20% regional premium, BYOK engineering and peering.
Priya (Presales): I'll add a short test plan to SOW: workload (10M tokens/mo), latency target p95 <120ms from NL POP, failover test to secondary EU region disabled for POC. I'll paste a quick test curl for them: ```curl -X POST https://eu-pilot.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"latency test"}]}'```
Nora (Security): Also need answers for their security questionnaire items: physical location of HSM, encryption-in-transit endpoints, which subprocessors have access to metadata, and whether any US-based support engineers will have access. We should state: support access is role-based and can be region-scoped; we can include an access policy appendix.
Ravi (Infra): Subprocessor list for EU-only POC: AWS (eu-central-1), EdgeNet EU (NL/DE POPs), VaultCorp EU (HSM), ManagedLog EU (eu-central-1), PacketRelay EU (bandwidth caching). I'll add links to the attestation docs in the SOW.
Diego (Sales): Legal: any must-have clause for SOW re: "no cross-border egress" and emergency fallback? They want zero cross-border unless an emergency with explicit written consent.
legal-bot: Automated note: please include Data Processing Agreement + EU SCCs template link. Add: "No cross-border egress during POC except with Customer written approval for named emergencies; all support sessions logged."
Nora (Security): We'll also require MFA and customer approval for any support session that could access keys. For BYOK, support will never request key material; only grant/attach operations performed via customer consent.
Hana (Ops): I'll produce a one-page runbook for handoff with CNAME template, ASN ranges, cert chain expectations, and DNS propagation checklist. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Presales): I'll assemble the tech appendix, test plan, and pasteable SOW blurb for Diego to include in quote. SOW blurb: "Redwood will provision a Dedicated EU-only tenancy in eu-central-1 for the POC. No cross-border egress will occur. Customer BYOK will be used and key material will remain in EU HSM. Support access will be region-scoped and logged."
Diego (Sales): This is great. Final ask: can Ops/Infra provide the exact IP prefixes + ASN so buyer's network team can pre-approve firewall rules?
Ravi (Infra): Yes. I'll post exact prefixes and ASN in the ticket once I carve the ephemeral tenant block (will be three /24s). Expect ranges by EOD.
Diego (Sales): Thanks everyone  I'll send provisional quote and attach SOW blurb. We can follow up with the security questionnaire answers in a separate thread.
